name: Blast Zone
desc:
An explosive fighting game with bombs, portals, jump pads, rocket-powered hammers, speed rails, flinging, and more!

Chat commands:
Say "rtv" to vote for maps
Say "listmaps" to list available maps
Say "loadmap Crossroads" to change the map (private server admin only)

Notes: 
Stats do not save in private servers, but you can still earn currency and rewards.
Players caught using exploits will be banned!
